agreement.service_s1_body:
This User Service Agreement (hereinafter referred to as this Agreement) governs the use of the Little Turtle Health Assistant Pro subscription service (hereinafter referred to as the Service). By actively checking the consent box and completing subscription, you acknowledge that you have fully read, understood, and agreed to be bound by this Agreement.

The Service provides premium features including: unlimited AI health consultations, voice input and output, unlimited report uploads, family member tracking (up to 6 members), full chat and metric history, and all-time trend charts.
agreement.service_s2_body:
The Service is offered on a subscription basis with the following billing cycles:
• Monthly: Billed every 30 days
• Quarterly: Billed every 90 days (with discount)
• Yearly: Billed every 365 days (with discount)

Subscription fees are charged at the beginning of each billing cycle. All prices are displayed in your local currency (CNY for Chinese users, USD for international users) and include applicable taxes. You have the right to be informed of the exact amount before each payment.
agreement.service_s3_body:
Auto-renewal is NOT enabled by default. You must explicitly opt in by checking the consent checkbox on the subscription page. Enabling auto-renewal requires your active, affirmative consent and cannot be pre-selected or assumed.

Before each auto-renewal deduction, we will send you a reminder at least 5 days in advance via email or in-app notification, clearly stating the renewal amount, deduction date, and how to cancel.

For complete auto-renewal terms, deduction timing, and cancellation procedures, please refer to the separate Auto-Renewal Service Agreement.
agreement.service_s4_body:
We accept the following payment methods:
• Alipay — for users in China
• WeChat Pay — for users in China
• Credit/Debit Card via Stripe — for international users

All payment processing is handled by certified third-party payment processors compliant with applicable financial regulations. We do not store your payment card details on our servers. Payment information is collected and processed separately with your explicit consent, independent of this Agreement.
agreement.service_s5_body:
New users may be eligible for a 30-day free trial of Pro features. The trial is one-time only and must be claimed within 30 days of registration. No payment information is required to start a trial.

After the trial period ends, your account will revert to the Free plan unless you subscribe to a paid plan. No charges will be made without your explicit action.
agreement.service_s6_body:
You may cancel your subscription at any time. Upon cancellation:
• You retain Pro access until the end of your current billing period
• You may request a proportionate refund for unused time in the current period by contacting customer support
• After the period ends, your account reverts to the Free plan

For auto-renewal charges that you did not intend, you may request a full refund within 7 days of the charge regardless of usage. For more details, see the Refund Policy section of the Auto-Renewal Service Agreement.

Refund requests: Email luoyu1106@163.com. Refunds are processed within 5-10 business days to your original payment method.
agreement.service_s7_body:
We may modify, suspend, or discontinue parts of the Service only for valid reasons including: regulatory compliance, technical requirements, or security concerns. Material changes to features or pricing will be communicated at least 14 days in advance via email and in-app notification.

If a material change adversely affects your use of the Service, you have the right to cancel your subscription and receive a proportionate refund for the remainder of your billing period.
agreement.service_s8_body:
As a subscriber, you agree to:
• Provide accurate payment information
• Not share your account credentials with others
• Use the Service in compliance with applicable laws
• Not attempt to circumvent usage limits or access controls
agreement.service_s9_body:
*** PLEASE READ THIS SECTION CAREFULLY ***

The health information provided by the AI assistant is for general reference and educational purposes ONLY. It does NOT constitute medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment.

This Service CANNOT replace consultation with licensed medical professionals. Do NOT self-medicate, change prescriptions, or discontinue treatment based on AI suggestions.

For any health concerns, symptoms, or medical decisions, always consult a qualified healthcare provider in person. In case of medical emergency, call emergency services immediately.

By using the Service, you acknowledge and accept this limitation.
agreement.service_s10_body:
For ordinary negligence, our total liability shall not exceed the amount paid by you in the last 12 months.

This liability cap does NOT apply to: (a) intentional misconduct or gross negligence on our part; (b) personal injury or health damage caused by our fault; (c) fraud or fraudulent misrepresentation; or (d) any other liability that cannot be limited by applicable law.

Nothing in this Agreement excludes or limits your statutory rights as a consumer under applicable law.
agreement.service_s11_body:
This Service is not intended for users under the age of 14. Users between 14 and 18 should use this Service under the guidance of a parent or legal guardian.

If you are a parent or guardian and believe a minor has subscribed without your consent, please contact us immediately at luoyu1106@163.com to cancel the subscription and request a full refund.
agreement.service_s12_body:
For questions, concerns, or complaints about this Agreement or the Service, please contact us through the following channels:

Email: luoyu1106@163.com
In-App: Settings → Help & Feedback

We will respond to your inquiry within 15 business days. If you are not satisfied with our response, you may file a complaint with the local consumer protection authority or the 12315 consumer hotline.
agreement.auto_renewal_s1_body:
This Auto-Renewal Service Agreement (hereinafter referred to as this Agreement) governs the automatic renewal of your Little Turtle Health Assistant Pro subscription.

Auto-renewal is NOT enabled by default. It requires your explicit, active consent through a separate checkbox on the subscription page. Auto-renewal cannot be activated through pre-checked boxes, default settings, or bundled consent. You must actively choose to enable it.

By enabling auto-renewal, you authorize us to automatically charge the applicable subscription fee to your payment method at the end of each billing cycle.
agreement.auto_renewal_s2_body:
Your subscription will renew according to your selected billing cycle:
• Monthly plan: Automatically renewed every 30 days
• Quarterly plan: Automatically renewed every 90 days
• Yearly plan: Automatically renewed every 365 days

The renewal fee will be the current subscription price for your billing cycle at the time of renewal. If prices change, you will be notified at least 5 days before the next renewal via email and in-app notification, and you will have the option to cancel before the new price takes effect.
agreement.auto_renewal_s3_body:
At least 5 days before each auto-renewal deduction, we will send you a prominent reminder via email and/or in-app push notification. This reminder will clearly state:
• The renewal amount to be charged
• The scheduled deduction date
• How to cancel auto-renewal before the charge

The renewal fee will be deducted from your payment method within 24 hours before the end of your current billing period. If the deduction fails, we may retry up to 3 times within a 3-day grace period.

If all retry attempts fail, your subscription will be downgraded to the Free plan. You will be notified of the failure.
agreement.auto_renewal_s4_body:
You may cancel auto-renewal at any time through any of the following convenient methods:

1. In the app: Go to Settings → Membership → Toggle off the Auto-Renewal switch
2. Via payment platform: Manage auto-debit settings directly in Alipay or WeChat Pay
3. Contact support: Email luoyu1106@163.com with your account email
4. In-app feedback: Settings → Help & Feedback

Cancellation takes effect at the end of your current billing period. You will continue to have Pro access until that time.

After successful cancellation, we will send you a confirmation notification (email and/or in-app) as proof of cancellation. Please keep this confirmation for your records.

Important: Cancelling auto-renewal does NOT immediately end your subscription. You retain full Pro access for the remainder of your paid period.
agreement.auto_renewal_s5_body:
Unconditional 7-day refund: If you are charged for an auto-renewal that you did not intend, you may request a full refund within 7 days of the charge, regardless of whether you have used Pro features during that period.

Proportionate refund: After the 7-day window, you may still request a proportionate refund for the unused portion of your billing period.

How to request a refund:
• Email: luoyu1106@163.com (include your account email and the charge details)
• In-App: Settings → Help & Feedback

Refunds will be processed to your original payment method within 5-10 business days.

If we fail to send the required pre-deduction notice (see Section 3), you are entitled to a full refund regardless of the 7-day window.
agreement.auto_renewal_s6_body:
Renewal charges will be made to the payment method used for your most recent subscription payment. You can manage your payment authorization through:
• Alipay: My → Settings → Payment Settings → Auto-Debit
• WeChat Pay: Me → Services → Wallet → Auto-Debit
• Stripe: Managed through the app

If your payment method is no longer valid or has been removed, auto-renewal will fail and no charge will be made. You will need to make a new subscription payment to continue the Service.
agreement.auto_renewal_s7_body:
Regarding your payment and subscription data, you have the right to:
• Access: View your complete payment history and subscription details at any time
• Copy: Export your payment records
• Correct: Request correction of inaccurate billing information
• Delete: Request deletion of your payment data (subject to legal retention requirements)
• Withdraw consent: Revoke auto-renewal authorization at any time

We will respond to any data rights request within 15 business days. Payment records are retained for 2 years after account deletion as required by financial regulations, after which they are permanently deleted.
agreement.auto_renewal_s8_body:
We may update this Agreement from time to time. Material changes will be communicated via email and in-app notification at least 14 days before they take effect. The notification will clearly describe what has changed.

If you do not agree with the updated terms, you may cancel auto-renewal before the changes take effect. Continued use of the auto-renewal feature after the effective date constitutes acceptance of the updated Agreement.
agreement.auto_renewal_s9_body:
If you have a dispute regarding auto-renewal charges, please first contact our support team (luoyu1106@163.com). We will investigate and respond within 15 business days.

If you are not satisfied with the resolution, you may:
• File a complaint with your local consumer protection authority
• Contact the 12315 consumer hotline (for users in China)
• Seek resolution through applicable legal channels
agreement.auto_renewal_s10_body:
For any questions about auto-renewal, billing, or this Agreement, please contact us:

Email: luoyu1106@163.com
In-App: Settings → Help & Feedback

We will respond within 15 business days.

privacy.title: Payment Processing Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Welcome to the subscription payment services of Little Turtle Health Assistant Pro (hereinafter referred to as “we” or “our”). This Payment Processing Privacy Policy (hereinafter referred to as “this Policy”) explains how we collect, use, store, and protect the information you provide during subscription payment and payment processing, ensuring the security of your information and your legitimate rights. Please read and understand this Policy carefully. By using our payment and subscription services, you agree to the processing of your information in accordance with this Policy.
privacy.section1_body:
This Policy applies to all registered users (hereinafter referred to as “you”) who use the subscription payment services of Little Turtle Health Assistant Pro, covering all information processing activities arising from subscription activation, renewal, payment, cancellation, and all other payment-related operations.

This Policy only addresses the processing of payment-related information and does not cover information processing rules for other services such as health consultations or data recording.
privacy.section2_body:
We follow the principle of “minimum necessity,” collecting only the information required to complete payment processing, subscription management, and security risk control. We do not collect redundant information unrelated to payment. The specific scope is as follows:

• Payment Order Information: Including order number, payment amount, payment time, payment method, payment status, and transaction reference number, used to confirm payment completion, reconcile bills, and process refunds

• Subscription Information: Including your selected billing cycle (monthly/quarterly/yearly), subscription activation time, renewal status, and subscription expiration time, used for subscription activation, renewal reminders, and service permission management

• Device Information: We only collect basic device information when you use payment services (including device model, operating system version, device unique identifiers such as IMEI/MAC address (used solely for security verification), and network type), strictly limited to security risk control to prevent fraudulent payments and unauthorized charges, and not used for any other purpose

• Payment Account Association Information: When you select a payment method, the basic information provided by third-party payment platforms (Alipay, WeChat Pay, Stripe) for payment verification (such as Alipay/WeChat nickname, last 4 digits of bound phone number, last 4 digits of credit card). We do not store complete payment account information (such as full bank card numbers or payment passwords)

Note: You have the right to refuse to provide non-essential information. However, refusing to provide device information may affect payment security verification and prevent you from completing payment or subscription.
privacy.section3_body:
We use collected payment-related information only for the following legitimate purposes, not exceeding the necessary scope, and not for business scenarios unrelated to payment or subscription:

• Payment Processing: Confirming payment instructions, completing transaction settlement, reconciling payment amounts, ensuring smooth payment processes, and handling payment failures, refunds, and other exceptions

• Subscription Management: Activating and extending your Pro service access based on subscription information, sending subscription expiration reminders and renewal notices, and synchronizing subscription status changes

• Fraud Prevention and Security Risk Control: Verifying the authenticity of payment activities through device and order information, identifying and preventing unauthorized charges, fraudulent payments, and malicious refunds

• Compliance and Dispute Resolution: Retaining payment records in accordance with laws, regulations, and financial compliance requirements for potential regulatory inspections, user complaints, and dispute mediation

• Service Optimization: Analyzing issues in the payment process based on anonymized, de-identified payment data (which can no longer be linked to specific users) to optimize the payment experience

We will not use payment-related information for health consultations, advertising, user profiling, or any other purposes unrelated to payment. We will not use personally identifiable payment information for any purpose without your explicit consent.
privacy.section4_body:
1. Auto-renewal services may only be activated with your explicit consent. When activating, we will prominently display (via a dedicated checkbox) the renewal cycle, amount, deduction timing, and cancellation method. Your confirmation and completion of the activation process constitutes consent to auto-renewal

2. During auto-renewal, we will only use your retained payment association information (synchronized by the third-party payment platform) to complete the deduction. No additional payment information will be collected

3. You may cancel auto-renewal at any time through Settings → Membership Center → Turn Off Auto-Renewal. Cancellation takes effect immediately, and no further automatic deductions will be made. You may continue to use Pro services within the current subscription period until the expiration date

4. If auto-renewal pricing changes, we will notify you at least 5 days before the next renewal via email, in-app push notifications, or other prominent methods. You may cancel auto-renewal before the new price takes effect to avoid being charged at the new rate
privacy.section5_body:
1. To complete payment processing, we engage certified third-party payment service providers (Alipay, WeChat Pay, Stripe) to process your payment instructions. These third parties will process your payment information in accordance with their own privacy policies and applicable laws and regulations

2. We only provide third-party payment providers with the information necessary to complete payment (such as order amount and order number). We will not provide them with your health information, complete personal identity information, or other unrelated content

3. We have signed confidentiality agreements with third-party payment providers, requiring them to strictly protect your payment information and prohibiting them from using your payment information for purposes unrelated to payment

4. We will not share your payment-related information with any advertising networks, data service providers, or other third parties, nor will we authorize third parties to use your payment information for advertising or commercial promotion purposes
privacy.section6_body:
We place great importance on the security of your payment information and adopt industry-standard security measures:

• Transmission Security: All payment-related information is transmitted using HTTPS/TLS encryption to ensure that information is not intercepted or tampered with during transmission

• Storage Security: We do not store your complete bank card numbers, payment passwords, verification codes, or other sensitive payment information. We only retain non-sensitive information such as payment orders and transaction records. Retained information is stored on servers that meet security standards, equipped with firewalls, data encryption, and other security systems

• Access Control: Access to payment information is strictly limited. Only authorized personnel (such as finance and customer service staff) may access relevant information in the course of their duties, and all access is fully traceable

• Security Audits: Regular audits of payment information processing procedures and security systems are conducted to promptly identify and fix security vulnerabilities

• Emergency Response: In the event of a payment information breach, tampering, or other security incident, we will immediately activate our emergency response plan, take remedial measures, and notify you and relevant regulatory authorities in accordance with legal requirements
privacy.section7_body:
1. The retention period for payment-related information strictly follows the principles of minimum necessity and financial compliance requirements: Payment orders, transaction records, and subscription information are retained for 2 years after your account is deleted

2. After the retention period expires, we will completely delete or anonymize your payment information (removing personally identifiable information and retaining only anonymized data that cannot be linked to specific users, for compliance auditing or service optimization)

3. If retention periods need to be extended due to regulatory requirements or dispute resolution, we will continue to apply security measures during the extended period, and the extension will not exceed the scope prescribed by laws and regulations
privacy.section8_body:
In accordance with the Personal Information Protection Law and other relevant laws and regulations, you have the following rights regarding your payment-related information:

• Right to Access: You may view all payment orders, transaction amounts, payment times, and other payment-related information at any time through the app

• Right to Copy: You may request a copy of your payment history. After contacting customer service, we will provide it within 15 business days

• Right to Correction: If you find errors in payment information (such as subscription cycle or payment amount), you may contact customer service to request corrections, and we will make corrections promptly after verification

• Right to Deletion: You may request deletion of your payment history (subject to financial compliance requirements; information already used for compliance auditing or dispute resolution is excluded). After account deletion, we will delete or anonymize all your payment information in accordance with this Policy

• Right to Withdraw Consent: You may withdraw your consent to payment information collection and use at any time (such as turning off auto-renewal or unbinding payment accounts). After withdrawal, we will no longer collect new payment information

• Right to Cancel Subscription and Delete Account: You may cancel your subscription at any time and may also request account deletion

To exercise these rights, please contact us through the methods specified in Section 11 of this Policy. We will respond to your request within 15 business days.
privacy.section9_body:
This service is not available to minors under the age of 14. Minors aged 14 to 18 must use our subscription and payment services under the supervision of their legal guardian and may only provide payment-related information with their legal guardian’s consent.

We will not collect information from minors beyond what is necessary for payment, nor will we allow minors to independently activate auto-renewal or make large payments. Legal guardians may contact us to inquire about, correct, or delete a minor’s payment information and exercise related user rights.
privacy.section10_body:
1. We may revise this Policy in response to updates in laws and regulations or adjustments to payment services. The revised Policy will clearly indicate the new effective date

2. If this Policy undergoes material changes (such as adjustments to the scope of information collection, purposes of use, or data retention periods), we will notify you at least 14 days before the changes take effect via email, in-app push notifications, or other prominent methods

3. Your continued use of our subscription and payment services constitutes your acceptance of the updated Policy. If you do not agree with the updated Policy, you may cancel your subscription or delete your account at any time
privacy.section11_body:
If you have any questions, concerns, or need to exercise your user rights, report complaints, or raise issues related to payment information, please contact us through the following channels:

Email: luoyu1106@163.com
In-App: Settings → Help & Feedback

We will respond to your inquiries, complaints, or requests within 15 business days. If you are not satisfied with the resolution, you may call the 12315 consumer complaint hotline or file a complaint with your local consumer protection association.

Supplementary Note: This Policy is a supplementary provision to the User Service Agreement and the Auto-Renewal Service Agreement and has equal legal force. In the event of any inconsistency between this Policy and the aforementioned agreements, this Policy shall prevail. Matters not covered by this Policy shall be governed by the aforementioned agreements and applicable laws and regulations.
